facts.text: The hotel is in the Jin Mao Tower in the Lujiazui Financial District.
facts.excerpt: Occupying floors 54 to 87 of the iconic Jin Mao Tower in the Lujiazui Financial District

facts.text: The hotel features an octagonal pagoda design.
facts.excerpt: the hotel features an octagonal pagoda design embodying exquisite oriental luxury

facts.text: The hotel has panoramic views of the Bund and the Huangpu River.
facts.excerpt: it commands panoramic views of the timeless Bund scenery and the glittering Huangpu River

facts.text: The hotel has a 33-storey central atrium.
facts.excerpt: the hotel’s soaring 33-storey central atrium creates an architectural masterpiece

facts.text: Rooms combine allusions to art deco heritage with classical Chinese style.
facts.excerpt: featuring allusions to art deco heritage combined with the essence of classical Chinese style

facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and a separate deep-soaking bathtub.
facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows offering sweeping views of the Pudong skyline welcome guests to this spacious 42 sq m (452 sq ft) room. Enjoy elegant art deco design, a generous work area, wireless Internet access, a separate deep-soaking bathtub

facts.text: Club rooms include access to the Grand Club Lounge, which serves breakfast, evening cocktails and hors d'oeuvres.
facts.excerpt: Includes access to the Grand Club Lounge offering a private boardroom and serving breakfast, evening cocktails and hors d'oeuvres.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has views of the skyline and the Bund, a kitchen, and a bath with a jet-spa tub and sauna.
facts.excerpt: suite that offers stunning skyline and the Bund views. Enjoy art deco design, a king bedroom, a sitting room, a work area with wireless Internet access, a kitchen, and a large bath with a jet-spa tub, high-pressure shower and sauna

facts.text: The Presidential Suite and Chairman Suite come with 24-hour butler service.
facts.excerpt: 24-hour butler service

facts.text: The sky-high pool has panoramas of the Shanghai skyline.
facts.excerpt: Feel alive in the sky-high pool, which features breathtaking panoramas of the Shanghai skyline.

facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours and private training instructors are available.
facts.excerpt: The 24-hour Fitness Center features extensive hi-tech equipment including cycling machines, spinners, treadmills, cross trainers and strength machines. Private training instructors are also available

facts.text: Cloud 9 on the 87th floor is a Western-style restaurant and sky-high lounge with full-scale Shanghai views.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 87‑floor tower top, Cloud 9 operates as a Western‑style restaurant and sky‑high lounge with full‑scale Shanghai views.

facts.text: Club Jin Mao on the 86th floor has private dining rooms with views over both banks of the Huangpu River.
facts.excerpt: Perched on the cloud‑high 86th floor of Jin Mao Tower, exclusive private dining rooms deliver a tranquil retreat with sweeping views over both banks of the Huangpu River.

facts.text: The hotel has seven restaurants and bars.
facts.excerpt: Our collection of seven distinctive restaurants and bars serves refined Chinese and international cuisines

facts.text: Yu Garden is 0.96 miles from the hotel.
facts.excerpt:
### Yu Garden

0.96 Miles away

facts.text: Shanghai Metro Line 2 is 0.6 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt:
Shanghai Metro Line 2

0.6 Kilometers

facts.text: Pudong International Airport is 40 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt:
Pudong International Airport (PVG)

40 Kilometers

facts.text: The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.
facts.excerpt: we recommend using local mapping applications such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map. International mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.

facts.text: Guests must wear a swimsuit and a swimming cap in the pool.
facts.excerpt: we kindly request that all guests wear an appropriate swimsuit and a swimming cap when using the pool

facts.text: Some room amenities are discontinued or only available on request as part of the hotel's sustainability commitment.
facts.excerpt: As part of our commitment to sustainability, certain room amenities are discontinued or only available upon request.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says the property starts on the 53rd floor.
facts.excerpt: Starting on the 53rd floor of the 88-story Jin Mao Tower, this property has views of the Huangpu River and the city beyond.

facts.text: The hotel occupies floors 54 to 87 of the Jin Mao Tower.
facts.excerpt: Occupying floors 54 to 87 of the iconic Jin Mao Tower

contradictions.note: p1 says floors 54 to 87; p7 (CNT) says starting on the 53rd floor
